title: Effect of Sintering Temperature on the Microstructure and Integrated Properties of MgAlTiVFeCo Lightweight High-Entropy Alloy

recollection.structure: Microstructure changes including phase formation and grain refinement
recollection.mechanism: Thermal activation leading to diffusion and phase stabilization
recollection.results: Improved mechanical and integrated properties at optimized sintering temperatures

score.note: The recollection only generically identifies temperature-dependent sintering, microstructural/phase changes, and thermally activated diffusion. It misses SPS at 1000 °C, the dense oxide barrier phases, passive-film and oxidation mechanisms, and all quantitative density, hardness, oxidation, and corrosion results.
